purpose: Diagnostic of versioned grounded-evidence rubric; not a new generation or Foundry Evaluations run.

validation.reason: The diagnostic nested findings and hallucinated_objects inside check_evidence rather than at the top level. The initial parser silently defaulted those missing lists; the corrected general validator rejects this shape offline.
agent_frame_review: The coffee maker has a percolator-like shape rather than the requested French press.
The cloth resembles a folded bag; its material is ambiguous.
The chair has four separate legs/casters rather than the requested five-wheel task-chair base.
A camera push-in progressively crops the mug and paper at opposite frame edges, contrary to the locked-off full-visibility requirement.
No visible writing was found in the four sampled frames. This is agent inspection, not human sign-off.

findings: No visible logos, signage, price numbers, slogans, or on-screen text.
Visible arrangement is left-to-right and includes coffee press/mug, cleaning spray/cloth, chair, and paper stack.
Packaging boxes appear plain and unbranded, but the visible colors do not fully match the prompt's specified muted indigo and warm ivory exactly.

The chair is present and generic, but the scene shows only three apparent boxes and the leftmost mug/coffee press sit on a dark box; overall grouping is close but not exact to the prompt's four separated groups and three-box packaging structure.
All objects appear stationary in a locked-off product shot; however, the composition is not a perfect match to the exact catalog layout requested.

However, the far-left mug is not fully visible because it is clipped by the frame edge, so the requirement that all six props remain fully visible is not met. No motion, cuts, or added objects are visible.

Three plain packaging boxes are visible and appear blank.
No logos, signage, text, or numbers are visible.
The far-left mug is partially cropped by the frame edge, violating full visibility.
The rightmost paper stack is close to the frame edge and appears slightly cropped in some frames.

usage.note: One v1 screening plus one v2 diagnostic; allowance is not a billed cost or price quotation.

prompt: A six-second silent product-catalog video, landscape 16:9, locked-off front-facing wide camera. One small-office supply kit arranged in exactly FOUR separated product GROUPS in a straight left-to-right row. There are exactly SIX product props in total, supported by THREE plain closed rectangular packaging boxes. Group 1 at far left: one stainless-steel French coffee press and one plain ivory ceramic mug, together on one matte muted indigo box. Group 2 at center left: one transparent unlabelled cleaning spray bottle and one folded ivory cleaning cloth, together on one matte ivory box. Group 3 at center right: one generic charcoal task chair with a simple padded rectangular back, padded seat and basic five-wheel base, standing on the floor, no box beneath it. Group 4 at far right: one stack of loose blank white printer paper with clearly visible fine sheet edges, resting on one matte muted indigo box. The mug and cloth belong to the kit; the three boxes are its packaging. All six product props and all three boxes remain fully visible, separated and stationary from first frame to last. Boxes are completely blank: muted dark indigo (#44416F) and warm ivory (#F6F4EF), with no bright blue or saturated violet. Seamless neutral light-grey floor and background, soft neutral daylight, realistic materials, no coloured lighting. No camera movement, cuts, opening boxes, transformations or added objects. No other furniture, electronics, plants or decor. No text, letters, numbers, labels, barcodes, logos, symbols, markings, signage, real brands or recognizable designer furniture. No people, hands or soundtrack.
